name: Rocketspark
description_en:
Rocketspark is a hosted website builder with visual editing, templates and optional professional design help. Its Website Builder plans combine hosting and SSL with pages, blog posts, forms and SEO tools; higher tiers add Flint AI writing, scheduled content, richer analytics and larger form allowances. Online-store subscriptions are a separate pricing choice.

Evaluate the recurring site service and any designer engagement separately. A plan includes one user, with additional users, business email and some advanced setup work charged separately. Trial expiry and cancellation can take the site offline, so retain content and plan domain/email continuity before ending service.
description_zh:
Rocketspark 是提供可视化编辑、模板和可选专业设计服务的托管建站工具。Website Builder 方案将托管和 SSL 与页面、博客、表单及 SEO 工具组合；更高档增加 Flint AI 写作、定时内容、完整分析及更大表单容量。在线商店订阅是另一项定价选择。

应分别评估持续网站服务和设计师工作。方案包含一个用户，额外用户、企业邮件及部分高级设置另行收费。试用到期和取消可能令网站下线，结束服务前应保存内容并规划域名/邮件连续性。

core_features.explanation_en: Templates, hosting and SSL are bundled; a designer can build the site for later self-editing, with design work quoted separately.
core_features.explanation_zh: 模板、托管及 SSL 打包提供，也可请设计师建站后自行编辑，设计工作单独报价。

core_features.name_zh: 分档表单与 AI 写作
core_features.explanation_en: Base includes 5 forms; Pro 200 plus upload/inbox tools and Flint writing; Pro+ expands forms and file-storage limits.
core_features.explanation_zh: 基础方案含 5 个表单，Pro 为 200 个并增加上传/收件箱和 Flint 写作，Pro+ 扩展表单及文件存储限制。

core_features.explanation_en: One new domain is free for the first year subject to registration conditions; business email and later domain costs remain separate.
core_features.explanation_zh: 一个新域名有条件首年免费，企业邮件及后续域名费用仍独立处理。

pricing.summary_en: Observed monthly website plans $29/$39/$90 before tax, one user; extras $3/user/month, business email and advanced setup. Annual/eCommerce separate. 30-day trial, no continuing free tier established.
pricing.summary_zh: 实读网站月付税前 $29/$39/$90，含一个用户；额外用户 $3/月，企业邮件及高级设置另费。年付/电商另核，提供 30 天试用，未确立持续免费档。

review_notes: Original English synthesis and corresponding Chinese translation from the attached primary sources. Vendor documentation does not establish independent testing or customer outcomes.
Original directory feature labels were replaced with product-specific documented capabilities. Unknowns and unreviewed alternatives remain unknown.

sections.title_en: Run a small website pilot before commissioning design
sections.title_zh: 委托设计前先验证一个小站
sections.en: The homepage offers starting from a template or hiring a matched designer. Use the 30-day no-card trial to create representative service and contact pages, then check mobile layouts, navigation, form delivery and editorial handover. The trial does not automatically bill at the end; it is not a permanent free hosting tier. Upgrading starts the paid period immediately even if trial days remain. Separate the ongoing builder subscription from custom design work, which the terms say is quoted and invoiced independently. No trial, editing or form workflow was executed here.
sections.zh: 首页提供从模板开始或匹配设计师代建两条路径。可用 30 天免卡试用创建代表性服务页和联系页，检查手机布局、导航、表单投递和编辑交接。试用结束不会自动收费，也不是永久免费托管；提前升级会立即开始付费周期，即使仍有剩余试用天数。持续构建器订阅应与设计工作分开，条款称后者独立报价和开票。本次未执行试用、编辑或表单流程。

sections.title_en: Use the observed USD site plans as a scoped quote
sections.title_zh: 按实读美元网站方案核价
sections.en: The global pricing page explicitly lists USD before tax: Website Builder $29/month, Pro $39 and Pro+ $90, billed monthly. Annual prices are a separate selector and were not read here. All three list unlimited pages/blog posts, storage/bandwidth, hosting and SSL, with one included user; extra users cost $3/user/month and business email is optional extra. Pro+ geo-redirection/CDN has a $175 setup fee. One newly registered domain is included for its first year with a website plan; existing domain connection and domain renewal are different matters. These are website-plan prices, not a confirmed eCommerce quote, and regional country selections can change currency.
sections.zh: 全球定价页明确为税前美元：Website Builder 每月 $29、Pro $39、Pro+ $90，按月结算。年付价格在另一切换状态，本次未读取。三个方案均列出不限页面/博客、存储/带宽、托管和 SSL，含一个用户；额外每用户每月 $3，企业邮件另购。Pro+ 地理重定向/CDN 有 $175 设置费。网站方案包含一个新注册域名首年费用，连接已有域名及后续续费是不同事项。这些是网站方案价格，不是已确认电商报价，地区选择也可能改变货币。

sections.title_en: Count forms, submissions and files independently
sections.title_zh: 独立计算表单、提交和文件容量
sections.en: Base permits 5 forms. Pro permits 200 and adds a forms inbox, date picker and file upload; its submission storage is 1,000 and form file storage 1 GB. Pro+ lists unlimited forms/submissions and 10 GB form files, so unlimited general site storage does not erase that upload limit. Pro adds scheduled content, comprehensive analytics and Flint AI page/blog writing, while Base includes Flint SEO tools. Confirm the AI usage/fair-use policy and whether submission storage is cumulative before using large lead campaigns. Test notification, export and deletion behavior with non-sensitive sample data rather than assuming a form is a complete CRM.
sections.zh: 基础档允许 5 个表单，Pro 允许 200 个，并增加表单收件箱、日期选择和文件上传；提交存储为 1,000、表单文件存储 1 GB。Pro+ 列出不限表单/提交及 10 GB 表单文件，一般站点存储不限不消除上传限制。Pro 增加定时内容、完整分析和 Flint AI 页面/博客写作，基础档含 Flint SEO 工具。大规模获客活动前应确认 AI 用量/公平使用政策，以及提交存储是否累计。应用不敏感样例数据验证通知、导出和删除，不能把表单当作完整 CRM。

sections.title_en: Schedule cancellation around site and domain continuity
sections.title_zh: 围绕网站及域名连续性安排取消
sections.en: The pricing FAQ says the site goes offline on cancellation and retains closed-account data for two months; the terms specify deactivation on the cancellation date you select, no obligation to refund the unused prepaid period, and a new bill if that date is past the next billing cycle. Clarify the effective date when scheduling an exit. Trial content is also retained at most two months after expiry before deletion. Domains and email may continue separately or be transferred; the terms require email notice if retaining domain registration after termination. Paid subscriptions auto-charge at renewal, with a reminder a week beforehand. An “on hold” plan is a support-arranged paid storage/hosting alternative, not a self-service pause or free preservation promise.
sections.zh: 定价 FAQ 称取消后网站下线，关闭账户数据保留两个月；条款明确按所选取消日期停用，不承诺退还预付剩余周期，所选日期跨过下一账期会再次收费，应在退出安排时确认生效日。试用内容到期后也最多保留两个月再删除。域名和邮件可独立继续或转移，条款要求终止后若保留域名注册需邮件通知。付费订阅自动续费，提前一周提醒。“on hold” 是联系支持安排的付费存储/托管替代，并非自助暂停或免费保存承诺。

sections.title_en: Know what the subscription and ownership permit
sections.title_zh: 了解订阅及使用权边界
sections.en: This is a plausible shortlist for a small business or designer seeking managed website infrastructure and human support. The terms reserve platform/software rights while distinguishing subscriber content and domain ownership; no open-source or self-hosted builder license is established. The sources did not demonstrate a full code export, restorable independent application or store migration. If those are requirements, obtain a concrete export specification and test the target host before cancelling. Claims about AI writing quality, SSL/search benefit, support quality and unlimited infrastructure are vendor descriptions, not measured outcomes. This research did not run a production site, pay, migrate domains or restore closed-account data.
sections.zh: 需要托管网站基础设施与人工支持的小企业或设计师可将其纳入候选。条款保留平台/软件权利，并区分订阅者内容和域名所有权，本次未确立开源或自托管构建器许可。来源没有展示完整代码导出、可独立恢复的应用或商店迁移。如有此需求，应取得具体导出规范并在取消前测试目标主机。AI 写作质量、SSL/搜索收益、支持质量及不限基础设施属于厂商描述，不是本次测量。本次未运行生产站点、付款、迁移域名或恢复关闭账户数据。

content_method.author: Codex (AI assistant)
content_method.method: Public primary-source research, original English editorial synthesis and Chinese translation. Hypothetical examples are not executed tests.

research_gaps.en: Annual/eCommerce prices, payment/transaction costs, AI usage limits, cumulative form retention and full code/data export were not verified.
research_gaps.zh: 未核实年付/电商价、支付/交易成本、AI 用量、累计表单保留及完整代码/数据导出。

research_gaps.en: No editor, domain/email migration, checkout, cancellation recovery or external-host portability was tested.
research_gaps.zh: 未实测编辑器、域名/邮件迁移、结账、取消后恢复或外部主机可迁移性。
